workSummary: Closed a formal-evidence mismatch where temporal shimmer/LOD frames still used a secondary RenderTexture plus Graphics.Blit after the still 4K packet had moved to a canonical in-place fixed-function MSAA resolve. Temporal frames now use the same native sRGB LDR target/readback boundary as still evidence, and stale pre-v1.1 temporal manifests/receipts are rejected for scoring.

details: QualityBlockTemporalStabilityCapture created resolveDescriptor/resolvedTarget and called Graphics.Blit(msaaTarget, resolvedTarget).
QualityBlockDisplayTransferIntegrityQA only recognized QA4K_ still targets, so QATemporal_ frames bypassed runtime sRGB/HDR/filmic-transfer validation.
Visual Fidelity temporal_lod_aliasing scoring could therefore be based on a different post-tonemap resolve/display-transfer path than hero/oblique/grazing stills.
Old temporal manifests did not identify a canonical no-shader-copy capture path and remained structurally acceptable to the temporal evidence validator.

changes.description: Added QualityBlockTemporalDisplayTransferIntegrityQA with source-bound and Camera.onPreCull fail-closed validation for QATemporal_subpixel_grazing and QATemporal_lod_walk_oblique targets.
Added machine-readable temporal_display_transfer_integrity_contract.json; runtime verification remains pending and this gate awards zero Visual Fidelity points.

Migrated temporal capture to bindMS=false, in-place ResolveAntiAliasedSurface and direct ReadPixels from msaaTarget; removed secondary resolve target/Graphics.Blit and invalidated pre-v1.1 temporal evidence.

sourceChecks: Temporal RenderTextureDescriptor explicitly sets bindMS=false and sRGB according to Linear project color space.
Temporal capture calls ResolveAntiAliasedSurface only when msaaSamples > 1, then sets RenderTexture.active=msaaTarget and performs direct ReadPixels.
Secondary resolveDescriptor/resolvedTarget and post-tonemap Graphics.Blit were removed from the temporal capture path.
Temporal manifest/receipt schema moved to 1.1 and scoring rejects older evidence.
Temporal manifest validation requires projectColorSpace=Linear and the exact canonical capture-source declaration.

Runtime QATemporal pre-cull guard requires 3840x2160, LDR sRGB target, bindTextureMS=false, no mipmaps, HDR camera, no dynamic resolution, and exactly one enabled filmic tonemap with ImageEffectTransformsToLDR.

expectedVisualScoreImpactNotAwarded.material_pbr: LOW_TO_MEDIUM because temporal frames now share the still display-transfer boundary

unityRuntimeFailureInjectionPlan: Run clean Unity 6000.3.0f1 temporal capture and verify QATemporal targets pass pre-cull with sRGB=true and bindTextureMS=false.
Reintroduce Graphics.Blit(msaaTarget, resolvedTarget) and require Temporal Display Transfer config validation to fail before capture.
Set bindMS=true and require QATemporal pre-cull failure.
Set temporal target sRGB=false and require pre-cull failure.
Enable dynamic resolution or disable/duplicate the filmic tonemap and require pre-cull failure.
Attempt to validate an old schema-1.0 temporal manifest/receipt and require recapture instead of scoring.
After clean recapture, inspect every 3840x2160 sequence and 100% crop for shimmer, thin-edge contrast drift and visible LOD pop before assigning temporal_lod_aliasing points.
nextBlocker: No Unity Runner/runtime evidence is available. GitHub Actions has no branch runs and no status contexts, so C# compile, actual RenderTexture.sRGB behavior, in-place MSAA resolve, temporal PNG output and visual temporal quality remain unverified.
